graph/description: **The supernova ruler.** Type Ia supernovae explode with nearly the same peak brightness, so how faint one looks says how far its light travelled: the distance modulus $\mu = m - M = 5\log_{10}\left(d_L / 10\,\mathrm{pc}\right)$. Each dot is one of Pantheon+'s 1,580 Hubble-flow supernovae, its $\mu$ minus what ΛCDM predicts (above 0: fainter, further away); white points are averages in redshift bins, the dashed curve the evolving dark energy fitted to all three rulers. *Be aware:* their absolute brightness $M$ is left free, so only the curve's shape counts, not its level. **Hover** a point.
